hardware: Raspberry Pi 5, 4 GB, aarch64; see parent manifest for system details.
code_verification: All five code_sha256 values captured by the probe match these files in commit 003482b. The measured 30-minute capitel baseline predates this deployment; no performance equivalence is claimed.
privacy: Aggregate statistics only; original JSON contains no images, coordinates, network addresses, credentials or absolute asset paths. Published byte-for-byte without redaction.

measurement_script.availability: Preserved byte-for-byte in repository; not imported by the production runtime.

reproduction.working_directory: Repository root with the installed production Python environment and Lite model assets.
reproduction.image_path: Replace /ruta/woman_hands.jpg with the local copy of the fixture; output must not already exist.
reproduction.model_provenance_scope: Installed Pose Lite and Hand Lite as reported by the probe; source URLs and expected hashes are in the model asset manifest. This probe did not independently hash installed model files.

measurement_scope.interpretation: Fresh tracker publications may include expiry; they are not independent video frames or ground-truth accuracy observations. PASS requires finite coverage of all eight inputs without contract errors, not detection in every publication.
measurement_scope.torso_coverage: Each torso input was finite in 179 publications and missing in 179; no nonfinite values or range violations. No cause of missing torso samples is established by this report.
measurement_scope.hand_proximity_coverage: Both hand proximity inputs were finite in all 358 publications.
measurement_scope.gating_scope: The five configuration-demand checks passed. A torso-visible/head-occluded physical sequence was not observed and is not validated.
measurement_scope.cpu: 64.53297641195746 percent of one logical core during the measured loop; excludes model startup and cleanup. No equivalent before/after comparison or resource improvement demonstrated.
measurement_scope.rss: 298.68032 MB decimal peak RSS for the entire process, including setup; not comparable to current RSS or model weight size.
measurement_scope.capture_failures: Zero before cleanup, one after replay teardown; both original snapshots are retained.
limitations: Single still-image replay cannot validate movement accuracy, occlusion recovery or true 3D distance.
Scale is a monocular relative proximity proxy, not absolute world.z or metres.
Missing torso or hand detections may make coverage incomplete; not automatically a runtime defect.
Body-only cadence with an occluded head is observed only if such frames occur.
Replay teardown can increment the final capture-failure counter; pre-cleanup metrics are separate.
No renderer, optical latency or comparison with historical system benchmarks.
